newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures finish listless trade mixed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures finish listless trade mixed.

text.p: March 21 - U.S. debt futures ended listless afternoon range-trading mixed. Late action stayed very calm and prices range-bound, with focus squarely on Tuesday's FOMC meeting. Some traders looked for slightly more curve-flattening into Tuesday in anticipation of tightening. June T-bonds hit intraday resistance near 108-24/32, additional at 109-00.
